==== task
ARG[--session-id]
ARG[<SESSION>]
ARG[-p]
ARG[GOLDEN-PROMPT

这次运行最多 4h（从启动算起），到时进程会被终止，还没写 ready.json 的部分交不出去。要等的东西（长跑、压测、soak、长时间观察）估计超过剩下的时间，就不在这次等完：跑一段放得进时限的缩短版拿证据，完整的那次写成一条命令放进交付说明，留给用户或之后的任务跑；不留还在跑的后台进程。离时限还剩半小时就收尾：提交并写好 ready.json。]
ARG[--model]
ARG[opus]
ARG[--effort]
ARG[high]
ARG[--permission-mode]
ARG[bypassPermissions]
ARG[--output-format]
ARG[json]
ARG[--disallowed-tools]
ARG[Monitor]
ARG[--name]
ARG[agentq demo 修登录]
ARG[--max-budget-usd]
ARG[150]
PWD[$ROOT/demo]

==== followup
ARG[-r]
ARG[s-old]
ARG[-p]
ARG[GOLDEN-PROMPT]
ARG[--model]
ARG[sonnet]
ARG[--effort]
ARG[medium]
ARG[--tools]
ARG[Read,Grep,Glob]
ARG[--strict-mcp-config]
ARG[--json-schema]
ARG[{"type":"object","properties":{"reply":{"type":"string","description":"发给用户的回答，Telegram HTML"},"todo":{"type":"string","description":"要改东西时写一句待办（标题 —— 要什么；验收：…），不用改就留空"}},"required":["reply"],"additionalProperties":false}]
ARG[--max-budget-usd]
ARG[1]
ARG[--output-format]
ARG[json]
ARG[--name]
ARG[agentq demo 接着问]
PWD[$ROOT/demo]

==== followup-files
ARG[-r]
ARG[s-old]
ARG[-p]
ARG[GOLDEN-PROMPT]
ARG[--model]
ARG[sonnet]
ARG[--effort]
ARG[medium]
ARG[--tools]
ARG[Read,Grep,Glob]
ARG[--strict-mcp-config]
ARG[--json-schema]
ARG[{"type":"object","properties":{"reply":{"type":"string","description":"发给用户的回答，Telegram HTML"},"todo":{"type":"string","description":"要改东西时写一句待办（标题 —— 要什么；验收：…），不用改就留空"}},"required":["reply"],"additionalProperties":false}]
ARG[--max-budget-usd]
ARG[1]
ARG[--output-format]
ARG[json]
ARG[--name]
ARG[agentq demo 接着问]
ARG[--add-dir]
ARG[$HOME/.agentq/jobs/<JOB>/files]
PWD[$ROOT/demo]
